senses.gloss: (b. h.) Succoth B’noth, name of an idol.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 63b:16">Snh. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>ס׳ ב׳</he> … <he>תרנגולת</he> Succoth B’noth (covering the young) … is a hen; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:2:3">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᶜ</cite> sq. <he>תרנגולתא ופרחיה</he> a hen and her chickens.
